tasks.short: Maintain laboratory operations by following specimen and safety standards

steps.what: Review current specimen collection, preparation and laboratory safety standards
Check actual specimens, preparation conditions and immediate laboratory hazards
Perform laboratory operations using the applicable specimen and safety procedures
Complete the existing required specimen preparation and safety check records

tasks.design: Use current procedure references and existing required check forms in {DOCS}. The cytotechnologist checks conditions, follows the procedures and separately captures the actual checks; no automatic compliance judgement is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Procedure navigation and repeated check-form context add handling around physical work.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document indexing and existing check headings can remove those operations.
tasks.still_hard: Actual specimen and safety conditions require direct inspection and response.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize when normal processing would be unsafe or unsuitable.
tasks.altitude: Reduce actual compliance-record repetition while retaining safe work.

reach.learn: Use actual observations rather than treating a completed form as proof of safety

evidence.claim: Current procedure links and existing check forms can reduce repeated context handling without performing laboratory safety work.

assumptions: The central baseline includes required preparation and safety check records already used for laboratory quality review; no new daily activity log is added. Their existence and writing share must be confirmed locally.

The cytotechnologist checks procedure version in s1, produces specimen and work-area observations in s2 and records actual specimen/batch identifier, date and performed check in s4. Capture is included in 12 retained form hours; missing observations are inspected manually, never prefilled as compliant.
Procedure indexing removes 3 of 15 navigation hours; stable batch and check headings remove 3 of 15 record-writing hours. All actual check content, physical work and ordinary author saves remain.
No machine consumes an assumed safety flag, creates an alert or releases specimens. Ordinary author saves have no approval stage.
unknowns: Actual required check records and their current headings
research_questions: Does reuse remove real repeated check context after direct inspection and substantive capture?

incremental.description: Maintain current procedure references and form context

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B=100, R=94, gross 6 less 1 upkeep gives 5 net. Already indexed procedures and an existing native check form retain all navigation and 14 record hours, offsetting the one hour removed with upkeep. Partly reusable required forms retaining 13 navigation and 13 record hours plus 70 physical work and 1 upkeep yield 3 net. No saving is claimed for observation or safe operations.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Provide clinical data and microscopic findings for pathology reporting

steps.what: Retrieve the patient's clinical data and existing microscopic findings for the pathology case
Determine which clinical data and microscopic findings are relevant to the pathologist
Write the case findings contribution in the existing pathology worksheet format
Check the exact case contribution, specimen linkage and receiving pathologist
Provide the checked contribution to the pathologist through the current internal channel

tasks.design: Use the native case-evidence view in {OTHER}, the pathology information system, and existing contribution headings in {DOCS}. The cytotechnologist selects and writes actual findings, checks the final contribution and separately provides it to the internal pathologist.
tasks.previous_blocker: Case navigation and repeated contribution context are reconstructed.
tasks.enabler_now: Native case links and existing worksheet structure preserve that context.
tasks.still_hard: Relevance and uncertainty must be judged before findings inform a pathology report.
tasks.human_edge: Convey the actual evidence without overstating its meaning.
tasks.altitude: Reduce case assembly around professional pathology support.

reach.learn: Distinguish observed findings from the cytotechnologist's uncertainty

evidence.claim: Native pathology case links and structured contribution headings can reduce repeated assembly; no local report-support saving is measured.

assumptions: The contribution worksheet already supplies data to the pathologist; no duplicate case report or communication log is introduced. The pathologist's final report writing is not transferred into this task.

The cytotechnologist verifies case, specimen, clinical data date and finding identifiers in s1, selects relevant facts in s2 and captures them in s3. Capture and checking remain in 17.5 writing and 10 final-check hours; missing links are manually reconciled.
The case view removes 5 of 25 navigation hours. Existing specimen context, clinical-data headings and finding structure remove 7.5 of 25 writing hours; finding meaning and uncertainty remain human.
The internal handoff stays fully retained. Its gate binds the final contribution provided, not an ordinary author save; a same-system save itself earns no saving.
research_questions: Does case-context reuse reduce assembly after verifying specimen linkage and substantive findings?

already_counted.description: Write actual contribution and check the handoff version

incremental.description: Maintain case links and contribution headings

approvals.approved_version: Exact case contribution, specimen linkage and internal pathologist recipient checked in s4; content or recipient changes invalidate the handoff check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B=100, R=87.5, gross 12.5 less 1.5 upkeep gives 11 net. Unlinked case evidence retaining all retrieval and 23.5 writing hours has its saving offset by upkeep. Compatible metadata retaining 22 retrieval and 19.5 writing hours plus other 50 and 1.5 upkeep yields 7 net. Relevance judgement, final check and actual handoff remain fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Assign laboratory tasks and coordinate adequate coverage

steps.what: Review laboratory tasks, staffing availability and required competence
Assign tasks while balancing urgency, staff competence and coverage
Write chosen task assignments in the existing laboratory allocation plan
Communicate the final task assignments to the allocated laboratory staff
Check assignment acceptance and resolve coverage problems with the relevant staff

tasks.design: Use native task context in {OTHER}, the laboratory information system, and existing availability and competence views in {HCM} and {LMS}. Reuse the allocation-plan fields in {DOCS}; the cytotechnologist chooses assignments, writes them and separately communicates the final version.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated task and staff navigation and allocation-plan context consume coordination time.
tasks.enabler_now: Native views and existing allocation fields can reduce those operations.
tasks.still_hard: Urgency, competence and changing workload require situational allocation judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Resolve coverage conflicts without assigning work beyond competence.
tasks.altitude: Reduce allocation assembly while preserving assignment decisions.

reach.learn: Check competence and actual availability before accepting allocation

evidence.claim: Native task and staff views and allocation fields can reduce repeated coordination handling without making staff assignments automatically.

assumptions: The allocation plan already records laboratory assignments used by staff. No extra assignment log or dashboard score is added.

The cytotechnologist verifies task identifiers, urgency, current availability and competence status in s1, chooses staff in s2 and captures task, assignee and timing in s3. All capture stays within 20 retained writing hours; missing availability or competence is checked manually with staff or the supervisor.
Native task and staff views remove 5 of 20 navigation hours. Reusable task and shift headings remove 5 of 25 allocation-writing hours; actual staff choice and coverage judgement remain human.
s4 is the actual internal communication with its final-version gate. Ordinary author saves in s3 remain retained without approval; no automatic allocation, booking or alert is implied.
unknowns: Completeness of native availability and competence context
research_questions: Does native context reduce total allocation work after manually reconciling staff constraints?

already_counted.description: Capture actual assignments and check allocation context

incremental.description: Maintain allocation fields and task/staff references

approvals.approved_version: Exact task, assignee, timing and staff recipients in the checked s3 allocation; changed content or recipients require rechecking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B=100, R=90, gross 10 less 1 upkeep gives 9 net. Stale staff metadata requiring full manual navigation and 24 allocation-writing hours has its one-hour saving offset by upkeep. Compatible task headings retaining 17 navigation and 21 writing hours plus other 55 and 1 upkeep yield 6 net. Allocation judgement, actual communication and coverage resolution remain fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Attend continuing education on laboratory issues

steps.what: Find current continuing education programs relevant to laboratory issues
Choose a suitable program and check its timing and participation requirements
outputs: chosen program and checked registration details

steps.what: Submit the checked registration to the external education provider
inputs: chosen program and checked registration details

steps.what: Attend the continuing education program and engage with the laboratory subject matter
Record actual course completion and evidence in the existing professional learning record

tasks.design: Use the current course catalogue and existing completion fields in {LMS}. Keep program choice, actual registration through {OTHER}, the education-provider portal, attendance and later evidence entry as separate phases.
tasks.previous_blocker: Catalogue navigation and stable completion context repeat administrative handling.
tasks.enabler_now: Native course references and existing learning-record fields can remove those operations.
tasks.still_hard: Learning requires attention and judgement about relevance to laboratory practice.
tasks.human_edge: Understand and apply what the education teaches.
tasks.altitude: Reduce actual education administration while retaining learning time.

reach.learn: Distinguish registration, attendance and verified completion

evidence.claim: Native catalogue and completion-record fields can reduce handling; attendance and learning remain human.

assumptions: The professional learning record already tracks actual completed education. No new reflective report or attendance log is introduced.

The cytotechnologist verifies course identity, date and requirements in s1-s2 and submits actual details in s3. The provider supplies existing completion evidence; the cytotechnologist checks and captures course, completion date, credit and evidence in s5 within 8.5 retained entry hours. Missing evidence is resolved manually with the provider.
Current catalogue links remove 2 of 10 course-search hours. Reusable course and learner context remove 1.5 of 10 completion-entry hours; evidence checking and ordinary saves remain.
Registration is a real external submission and stays fully retained. Later record saves need no approval and receive no separate saving.
unknowns: Compatibility of provider evidence with current learning fields
research_questions: Do existing catalogue links and completion fields reduce actual administration after verifying evidence?

already_counted.description: Capture and verify actual completion evidence

incremental.description: Maintain current catalogue and completion headings

approvals.approved_version: Exact course, participant details, date and registration terms checked in s2; changed terms or course require renewed checking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B=100, R=96.5, gross 3.5 less 0.5 upkeep gives 3 net. External courses lacking reusable identifiers retain all search and 9.5 completion-entry hours, offsetting their half-hour saving with upkeep. Compatible course references retaining nine search and nine completion hours plus other 80 and 0.5 upkeep yield 1.5 net. Choice, registration and learning stay fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Retain specimen safety, pathology support judgement and continuing learning while reducing existing record repetition.
reach: Keep laboratory coverage and learning evidence explicit
skills_to_grow: Keep assignment and education phases separate
role.ambitious_version: A cytotechnologist with usable case evidence and clearer coordination who remains responsible for safe laboratory practice and professional learning.
